User.title: User Profile
User.description: Core citizen and municipal worker profiles, managing identity and gamification rewards.

id.description: The unique system identifier for the user (typically Google Auth UID or email).

name.description: Human name of the citizen or worker.

email.description: Electronic mail address used as the primary identifier.

department.description: Assigned department (only applicable if role is authority or admin).

verificationsDone.description: Total count of community incident verifications completed.

reportsFiled.description: Total count of public issue reports filed by the user.

gameCompletedCount.description: Total count of interactive municipal guidelines quiz completions.

Report.title: Community Issue Report
Report.description: Report of a public municipal issue filed by a citizen, analyzed by Gemini AI, and tracked through resolution.

title.description: Short catchy title generated by AI based on the user's report details.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue written by the reporter.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the incident.

department.description: Municipal department currently assigned to resolve the incident.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp indicating when the report was submitted.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp indicating the last update to this report.

imageUrl.description: HTTP URL of the photo evidence of the incident.

verifications.description: Array of reporter/user email strings or IDs who verified this issue.

resolutionProofUrl.description: HTTP URL of the photo uploaded by city workers verifying resolution.

resolutionProofDescription.description: Description of actions taken to solve the issue.

aiConfidence.description: Confidence score from Gemini computer vision or text model (0.00 to 1.00).

aiReasoning.description: Diagnostic explanation from Gemini detailing why the category/severity was chosen.

Department.title: Municipal Department
Department.description: A city utility or administrative unit managing staff and resolving designated issue types.

manager.description: Full name of the designated director or chief.

activeStaffCount.description: Number of active workers available in the department roster.

Authority.title: Authority Profile
Authority.description: Extended credentials and job-tracking properties for municipal agency workers.

id.description: User identifier matching the primary User Profile document ID.

departmentCode.description: Code of the assigned department (e.g., DOT).

role.description: Hierarchy tier inside the municipal branch.

activeWorkOrders.description: List of report IDs assigned to this individual.

Verification.title: Verification Audit Log
Verification.description: Audit record tracking who upvoted/downvoted which report to maintain transparency and check collusion.

id.description: Unique key usually structured as userId_reportId.

userId.description: Email or ID of the validating citizen.

pointsEarned.description: Reward points granted for this contribution (e.g. 10).

Reward.title: Reward Voucher Catalog
Reward.description: Catalog of claimable digital rewards, vouchers, or neighborhood utility discounts citizen-points can buy.

id.description: Unique ID of the reward item.

title.description: Name of reward (e.g., Free City Bus Pass).

pointsCost.description: Required citizen-points balance threshold to claim.

claimedCount.description: Total number of times citizens have claimed this voucher.

Notification.title: Notification Alert
Notification.description: In-app alerts triggering on milestones, issue assignments, or status updates to close the loop.

title.description: Short bold header of the notification.

message.description: Main descriptive body of the notification.

read.description: Read flag to power badge notification counts.

relatedEntityId.description: Optional report ID or badge ID for contextual navigation.

PredictionHistory.title: Predictive Analytics Forecast
PredictionHistory.description: A historic snapshot of Gemini AI's spatial and seasonal hotspot forecasts.

region.description: Focal zone predicted (e.g. Capitol Hill Corridor).

reasoning.description: Multi-variable analytical justification generated by Gemini AI.

predictedTimeline.description: Season or calendar window of high threat.

LeaderboardEntry.title: Leaderboard Standings Entry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Denotes static score totals cached for rapid leaderboard render cycles.

userId.description: Email or ID of the citizen.

role.description: Aesthetic rank badge (e.g. Civic Sentinel, Active Neighbor).

StatusHistory.title: Status Workflow Audit
StatusHistory.description: Chronological audit logs capturing every status change of reported issues.

changedBy.description: Email or user ID of the official, or 'System/AI'.

comment.description: Contextual details on why the status changed.

/users/{userId}.description: Primary user directory indexed by user email or UID.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Directory of citizen incident reports and physical diagnostics.

/departments/{departmentCode}.description: Directory of active municipal agencies operating in the city.

/authority/{authorityId}.description: Extended credentials, clearance profiles, and active assignments for municipal workers.

/verifications/{verificationId}.description: Frictionless audit ledger log capturing citizen validations.

/rewards/{rewardId}.description: Neighborhood claimable discounts and eco-voucher shop catalog.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Individual in-app alerts mapped to user IDs.

/prediction_history/{predictionId}.description: Historical spatial hotspots predicted by Google Gemini models.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: High performance cached standings listing active civic contributors.

/status_history/{historyId}.description: Comprehensive audit trails of state transitions for reported incidents.
